_source: Copied word for word from the live poloslounge.com #banquet section on 13 Oct 2026. Owner to confirm packages and prices are current.
title: Celebrate With Us
intro: Elevate your occasion with Polos Social Lounge Banquet & Catering. Offering a diverse selection of cuisines, exceptional service, and customizable menu options.
booking_fee: A $250 non-refundable reservation fee is required to secure your booking. The $250 will be applied toward your banquet room rental fee. In the event of a cancellation, the reservation fee is non-refundable.

packages.name: Appetizer Buffet
packages.description: Premium Chicken Wings with hot & honey garlic sauces, Loaded Cheesy Nachos with sour cream and salsa, Thai Chilli Chicken Bites, Assorted Pizzas, Bruschetta, Mixed Green Salad and soft drinks.

packages.name: Soup & Sandwiches
packages.description: Assorted Sandwiches & Wraps (Deli Meat, Chicken Salad, Egg Salad, Tuna Salad, Vegetarian), Chef's Daily Soup, Classic Caesar or Mixed Greens, Assorted Dessert Squares and soft drinks.

packages.name: Build Your Burger
packages.description: Homemade Beef Burger Patties, Kaiser Buns, French Fries, Cheese, Lettuce, Tomatoes, Onions, Pickles, Mayonnaise, Mustard, Assorted Dessert Squares and soft drinks.

packages.name: Hot Pasta Lunch
packages.description: Penne Alfredo with roasted chicken & Spaghetti Meatballs, Garlic Toast, Classic Caesar or Mixed Greens, Assorted Dessert Squares and soft drinks.

packages.name: Lunch Package
packages.description: Freshly Baked Rolls, Caesar or Mixed Greens, Dessert Squares, soft drinks. Choose one starch, one chicken dish and one beef dish.

choices.label: Chicken (choose one)
choices.options: Chicken Breast (tomato or mushroom sauce), Italian Roasted, Cajun Baked, Chicken Parmesan, Chicken Alfredo, Butter Chicken, Chicken Stir Fry

choices.label: Beef (choose one)
choices.options: Roasted Beef with gravy, English Cut Roasted Beef Au Jus, Beer-Braised Brisket, Beef Stroganoff, Beef Stir Fry

packages.name: Dinner Package
packages.description: Dinner Rolls, Mixed Greens, Classic Caesar Salad, Vegetable Platter, Cheese Platter, Seasonal Vegetables, Fruit Platter, Dessert Squares, soft drinks. Choose one starch, one chicken and one beef dish.

choices.label: Chicken (choose one)
choices.options: Chicken Breast (tomato or mushroom sauce), Italian Roasted, Cajun Baked, Chicken Parmesan, Chicken Alfredo, Coq Au Vin, Butter Chicken, Chicken Stir Fry

choices.label: Beef (choose one)
choices.options: Roasted Beef with gravy, English Cut Roasted Beef Au Jus, Beer-Braised Brisket, Beef Stroganoff, Beef Stir Fry

bar.title: Bar Service
bar.text: Standard and premium alcohol options including full bar service with 16 beers on tap. Cash bar, all-on-one-tab, or ticket service available.
bar.note: Ask your event coordinator for further information on beverage packages.

allergy: At Polos Social Lounge, we take allergies seriously. However, we cannot guarantee a completely allergen-free environment due to the possibility of cross-contamination. Please inform our team of any dietary needs.
